findings.title: Declare return types on exported functions
findings.message: The exported function `computeLineTotal` in src/billing/helpers/compute-line-total.ts lacks an explicit return type annotation. Add an explicit return type to make the contract clear and prevent silent type changes on refactoring.

claims.claim: The exported function `computeLineTotal` in src/billing/helpers/compute-line-total.ts has an explicit return type annotation.
claims.reason: The diff shows the function definition at line 5 of the new file: `export function computeLineTotal(item: LineItem): InvoiceLine {`. The function clearly has an explicit return type annotation of `InvoiceLine` specified after the parameter list.

claims.claim: The exported function `computeLineTotal` lacks an explicit return type annotation.
claims.reason: The diff shows the function has an explicit return type annotation `InvoiceLine` at line 5. This directly contradicts the claim that the function lacks a return type annotation.

claims.claim: Explicit return types on exported functions prevent silent type changes on refactoring.
claims.reason: The rule document states: 'Explicit return types are a contract — they prevent an internal refactor from silently widening the public type.' This directly supports the claim about preventing silent type changes.
